text:
trevor: Quick check — can we run the weekly GPU capacity forecast with 3 scenarios? baseline, holiday-surge (+35%), and outage-fallback. Need per-region runway (hours) and suggested node mix (A100/reserved vs spot). I started a small sim and put a link: https://rwd.in/ops/forecast-340123. Can folks post quick numbers by EOD?
anita: Baseline numbers from my side — US: 72h runway, EU: 48h, APAC: 30h. Baseline assumes current reserved + 20% burst capacity. Holiday-surge pushes EU demand to ~18k GPU-hours/day — roughly need +120 A100s or offload to quantized variants.
lucas: Cluster-level notes: us-west2-gpupool runway ~60h; us-east1 has burst capacity but hits net egress limits. eu-north can't scale >40 nodes without peering change (infra-1234).
maya: Heads up — eu-west1 peering change still pending (infra-1234). Adding nodes there spikes egress and costs (~$0.12/token-hour). For EU surge, prefer eu-west2 fallback or enable more aggressive prefix caching on the tiered cache.
jeff: Spot risk: preemptible eviction prob up ~18% in apac-west this week. For surge, prefer reserved capacity in APAC or plan fallback to shorter sequence lengths for lower-priority workloads.
sre-oncall: Observed ~0.8% packet loss on apac-west1 interconnect this morning at ~07:12 UTC, caused tail latency bumps. Ops retried but recommend avoiding routing canaries to apac-west1 until net team confirms.
anita: Quick cost summary: holiday-surge ~+42% monthly cost vs baseline. Option A: add 150 A100 reserved (more predictable, +~30% cost). Option B: add 300 T4 spot + quantized models (cheaper +~18% cost but potential quality hit).
trevor: Can someone run sims for both mixes? I dropped a tiny runner in infra-tools repo:
```bash
./run-forecast --scenario holiday-surge --mix reserved:150A100,spot:300T4 --horizon 7
```
lucas: On it — running sims for Option A & B and a hybrid. Note: shifting ~15% of reranks to tiny-embed model saves ~22% token cost in sims.
infra-bot: cost-alert created: forecast-holiday-surge (threshold: 30% over baseline) — https://rwd.in/alerts/12345 :bell:
maya: Scheduling note — eu-west maintenance Fri 02:00-05:00 UTC reduces EU runway by ~3h unless rescheduled. That might affect canary rollouts during surge.
jeff: I'll prioritize an APAC reserved quote and loop in sales for pricing ASAP.
trevor: Great. lucas + anita please post a 3-line summary (runway delta, cost delta, recommended node mix) by 16:00 PST. If procurement needed, flag it in-thread. Thanks :thumbsup:
